card_text: Kids' haircuts planned from Roswell: book each child their own slot, line them up, and make one trip of it.

seo.title: Kids' Haircuts for Roswell, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Kids' fades and tapers for families driving from Roswell, cut in Carlsbad about 92 minutes south on US 285. One Booksy slot per child, back to back.

paragraphs: Kids get the same fades and tapers in my chair that adults do, cut at my shop in Carlsbad. From Roswell that's {{city:roswell.drive_mi}} miles down {{city:roswell.route}}, around {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes with a kid in the back seat (OpenStreetMap routing).
Here's how parents make the trip count: one slot per child, booked in a row, and a photo of the cut they want.

blocks.heading: One in four, so bring them all.
paragraphs: A quarter of Roswell is under 18, {{city:roswell.under18_pct}} by the Census (ACS 2023), so many homes have more than one head to cut. Booksy has no separate kids' service, which means each child books a regular haircut in their own slot. Pick slots that touch each other, put yours on the end, and the whole family is done in one visit instead of two drives.
I work alone, so the kid who was nervous last time sees the same face this time.

blocks.heading: The Essential, with a picture.
paragraphs: For most kids the Essential Haircut is the booking: {{price:essential-haircut}}, with {{minutes:essential-haircut}} held on Booksy. A low fade with a line-up, a taper under a longer top, or curls over a skin fade all fit inside that time. Lines cut in are a {{addon:hair-design}} add-on.
Save a photo on your phone before you leave Roswell. Showing me the cut beats describing it, especially with a kid who isn't sure what to call it.

blocks.heading: What each child books.
blocks.lead: Kids book the same services as adults.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: A full cut with a clean neckline, sized to a smaller head. Book one per child.

items.q: Can two kids share one appointment?
items.a: Each child needs their own slot so I can give both the full time. Book them back to back.

items.q: What's the drive like with kids from Roswell?
items.a: About {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes each way on {{city:roswell.route}}, with Artesia roughly halfway if anyone needs a stop. The shop is at {{address}}.

items.q: When are you open on weekends?
items.a: Saturdays, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. With about {{city:roswell.k12_students}} kids in K–12 school in Roswell (Census ACS 2023), that Saturday window is how families avoid missing class for a {{city:roswell.drive_min}}-minute drive. Closed Wednesdays and Sundays.
